title: PR #127: Fix connection pool timeout handling
subtitle: repo: acme/api-gateway -- opened by @alex

content.body:
## AI Review Summary

This PR fixes a race condition in the connection pool timeout handling that could cause requests to hang indefinitely when the pool is exhausted.

**Risk Assessment**: Low

The fix adds proper cancellation token propagation and a configurable fallback timeout.
